metadata.Name: STAIR Captions
metadata.Description: A large-scale Japanese image caption dataset based on images from MS-COCO, consisting of 820,310 Japanese captions for 164,062 images.
metadata.Paper Title: STAIR Captions: Constructing a Large-Scale Japanese Image Caption Dataset
metadata.Abstract: In recent years, automatic generation of image descriptions (captions) has attracted a great deal of attention. In this paper, we particularly consider generating Japanese captions for images. Since most available caption datasets have been constructed for English language, there are few datasets for Japanese. To tackle this problem, we construct a large-scale Japanese image caption dataset based on images from MS-COCO, which is called STAIR Captions. STAIR Captions consists of 820,310 Japanese captions for 164,062 images.
